notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic land you control.
Repeat.
